newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian insurer's '95 profit rises to 23 mln kuna.
newsitem.headline: Croatian insurer's '95 profit rises to 23 mln kuna.

text.p: Croatia's largest insurer Croatia Osiguranje d.d. almost doubled its net profit to 23.0 million kuna for the year ended December 31, 1995, from 13.6 million kuna in 1994.
Croatia Osiguranje pre-tax profit rose to 31.9 million from 21.0 million kuna, according to its audited full-year figures published in financial weekly Privredni Vjesnik.
Total 1995 revenues were boosted to 2.2 billion kuna from 1.9 billion in the previous year, with costs up 76 million to 1.58 billion. There was no other comment from the board.

In 1995, the insurance firm's balance sheet strengthened to 2.3 billion from 1.9 billion kuna. Its equity capital rose to 583.7 million from 556.3 million kuna, with reserves shrinking some 20 million kuna to 104.7 million.
